description: Crop any photo into a perfect circle with transparent corners — ideal for avatars.

faqs.a: The largest circle that fits inside your photo is kept; everything outside becomes transparent.
Yes — only PNG keeps transparency. JPEG would fill the corners with a solid color.
faqs.q: Why is the download a PNG?

faqs.a: Avatars, profile pictures, logos and stickers.

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Image Circle Crop
